prompt.description: Video generation prompt, length is between 1 and 7000 characters.
examples: Let the character in the scene turn around naturally and smile, camera slowly pushing forward

first_frame_url.description: First frame image URL. Note: Either first_frame_url or last_frame_url must be provided. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, and OSS addresses; supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, HEIF formats; single image size not exceeding 30 MB, image side length between 256 and 5760 pixels, aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.

last_frame_url.description: Last frame image URL. Note: Either first_frame_url or last_frame_url must be provided. Image restrictions are the same as first_frame_url.

duration.description: Generated video duration, supporting integer values from 4 to 15 seconds.
